basics.name: Othmane Triki
basics.label: Data Analyst
basics.summary: Data Analyst at Betclic Group, with 4+ years at the company and four roles since 2022 (Growth Executive, Growth Project Manager, Data Analyst). Builds marketing dashboards, analytical datasets and automated reporting that turn campaign and customer data into growth decisions, and coordinates Marketing, Acquisition and Data teams across markets. Software development background (EPITECH, Master’s-level) with SQL, Python, Snowflake and Excel.
